units.source_text: ——一看到这个工人，良平带着两个小孩儿早就逃到十来米开外了。

en.t: As soon as he saw the workman, Ryohei had already fled more than ten meters away with the two children.

units.source_text: ——自此以后，良平偶尔有事经过那里时，就算看到矿车停在没人的工地上，也不想再去碰矿车了。

en.t: From then on, even when Ryohei happened to pass that place on some errand and saw a trolley standing at the deserted work site, he no longer wanted to touch it.

units.source_text: 而那个骂过自己的工人的模样，一直留在良平的脑海里。

en.t: And the figure of the workman who had scolded him remained in Ryohei's mind.

units.source_text: 一顶小小的黄色的麦秸草帽，在夜幕中总是浮现。

en.t: A small yellow straw hat was always appearing in the darkness of night.
